feature_text: No increase in Double negative TCRαβ+ T cells
No abnormalities were noted in the vulva and perianal areas
No abnormalities in the heart and lungs
many WBC could be seen in the stool
severe inflammatory swelling of skin after vaccination
positive double-stranded DNA (dsDNA; enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay)
antineutrophil cytoplasmic antibody panels were negative
no autoimmune manifestation up to the age of 14
necrotizing lymphadenitis suggestive of Kikuchi disease
hyperpyrexia with a temperature spike > 38.5 °C (axillary temperature)
complete blood count (CBC) within the normal range (no cytopenia)
multiple ulcerations of the terminal ileum, ileocecum, stomach and duodenum
urine, stool, and blood cultures normal
Rubella, CMV, Toxoplasma, and EBV IgM negative
Normal numbers of CD3+, CD4+, CD8+ T, NK and B cells
Nitroblue tetrazolium (NBT) test was also normal
BCG vaccination scar and tonsils appeared normal
blood and CSF cultures were negative
hemophagocytosis picture was not detected (bone marrow aspiration)
CMV, toxoplasmosis, rubella, and HIV serology within normal limits
Blood viral loads of EBV and CMV were undetectable
leishmaniosis, brucellosis, tuberculosis, and mycoplasma negative
immunoglobulin levels were within normal limits
leukocyte exocytosis of the epidermis and histiocytic and lymphocytic inflammation of the dermis
Fecal occult blood test (FOBT) turned out positive
abnormality on abdominal examination (apart from the palpable spleen)
peeling of skin at the junction of perianal, finger and toe nails
abnormal thyroid function (T3, T4, FT3, FT4)
reactive hyperplasia of left inguinal lymph node (biopsy)
special abnormalities in rheumatologic immune indicators
inflammatory fibroepithelial polyp on the arytenoid
cardiac and vascular color Doppler ultrasound normal
